summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing an Exhibit 99.1 press release dated November 3, 2026, announcing the appointment of Terry Ryan to its Board of Directors. Ryan is a former federal intelligence official and defense-technology executive, past CEO of Constellis and Tenax Aerospace and an alumnus of SAIC/Leidos predecessor, ManTech, Mercury Systems and SRA International. CEO Patrick Blott framed the appointment as supporting Intermap's multi-domain GEOINT expansion. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock are disclosed. This is a routine board appointment rather than a forced or abrupt management change; no deal or special-situation angle to watch.
